title: Stagewise Koszul derived Hom and restriction-compatible comparison
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f a finite sequence, and U its principal-open union. Use the tails, objects and power transitions of [def-sc-koszul-open-system], and the module Hom-complex diagram D and derived comparison of [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Let F be a termwise quasi-coherent complex on Spec A, let E be a quasi-coherent derived object [def-pc-derived-category], and specify an isomorphism Q(F) to E. Put M equal to the global-sections complex of F. There are additive equivalences alpha_e from Hom(I_e,E) to H^0(D_e), natural for the power transitions. Write beta for the homology map of the canonical derived comparison to RΓ(U,E), preceded by the inverse localization/homology comparison. If the derived restriction of phi to U is zero, then beta sends H^0(iota_e)(alpha_e(phi)) to zero. No assertion about homology of a filtered colimit or about invertibility of the derived comparison is made.

proof.text: Construct the termwise affine counit isomorphism s using Mathlib Scheme.Modules.fromTildeGamma for the quasi-coherent terms of F, with naturality giving its complex compatibility. Let q=Q(s) followed by eF. The module tail is K-projective: each exterior-power term is free and hence projective, and extension of the natural-number chain complex is strictly bounded above.

Apply affineKProjective_homComplex to M. Postcomposition with q inverse transports Hom(I_e,E) to Hom(Q(T(L_e)),Q(T(M))); then transport homology back through koszulCechHomObjIso inverse to define alpha_e as a composite of additive equivalences. Conjugate D.map by the object isomorphisms. The formula in koszulCechHomDiagram_exists is the precomposition formula required by the generic theorem. Its naturality followed by homologyMap_comp and cancellation of j_y with its inverse proves the transition identity.

For phi, use the generic representative clause to obtain a chain map g and cycle z, whose homology projection is the identified class. Cancel q inverse with q to show Q(Tg) followed by q equals phi. Apply koszulChain_restriction_formula with psi=0: the augmentation equation follows from comp_zero and R.map(phi)=0. Since b is additive b(0)=0. Transport its resulting equality along the class identity for alpha_e and reverse it to obtain the required zero.

proof_origin.place: Stagewise derived Hom identification and restriction comparison, through generic affine representatives and the chain-level fraction formula

theorem koszulOpenHom_homology_comparison
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (eF : DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ≅ E.obj) :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let M := ((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F
    let D := koszulCechHomDiagram A r f M
    let C := koszulCechHomColimit A r f M
    let β := ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).app C).inv ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).map
        (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F ≫
          (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor.map eF.hom)
    ∃ α : ∀ e : ℕ, (koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ E.obj) ≃+ (D.obj e).homology 0,
      (∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) (φ : koszulOpenObject A r f a ⟶ E.obj),
        α b (koszulOpenMap A r f a b h ≫ φ) =
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (D.map (homOfLE h)) 0 (α a φ)) ∧
      ∀ (e : ℕ) (φ : koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ E.obj), R.map φ = 0 →
        β (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (colimit.ι D e) 0 (α e φ)) = 0
